text:
Palladium Price in 2013
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2013, the LBMA palladium price fell 3.1% between 2013-01-31 ($739) and 2013-12-30 ($716). The highest sampled price was $770 in March and the lowest was $643 in June. The mean of these observations was $726. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
